title: Who Made GTA 6? Rockstar's 13 Offices and Where It Is Based
desc: GTA 6 was made by Rockstar Games, led by founder Sam Houser and based in New York City. Its 13 offices, its president, and where it was hiring after launch.
keywords: who made gta 6, who created gta 6, where is rockstar games based, rockstar games headquarters, president of rockstar games, rockstar games studios, rockstar games development team, rockstar ceo, rockstar games jobs
question: Who made GTA 6, where is Rockstar Games based, and who runs it?
cta: Launching something big? Have its security checked before the traffic arrives.
body:
Short answer. GTA 6 was made by Rockstar Games, the label Sam Houser founded in 1998; Take-Two's release of November 20, 2026 names him "President and Founder." As of November 25, 2026, Rockstar listed 13 offices on its careers page, from Rockstar North in Edinburgh to Rockstar San Diego in Carlsbad, California, and its corporate offices are in New York City.

On November 25, 2026 we read Rockstar's own careers and job openings pages, Take-Two's annual report (Form 10-K) for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 and its launch release, both filed with the US Securities and Exchange Commission. Below: where each Rockstar office is, who leads the company, how big the studios are, and what Rockstar's job listings showed six days after launch.

Who made GTA 6

Grand Theft Auto VI is a Rockstar Games release. Rockstar announced on November 19, 2026 that the game "is now available worldwide for PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S." The next day, Take-Two's launch release described Rockstar Games as "a label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO)."

Rockstar builds its own games. Take-Two's Form 10-K for the year ended March 31, 2026 says: "Software titles published by our Rockstar Games label are primarily internally developed." That is a general statement about Rockstar's titles, and neither filing names an outside developer for GTA 6.

What the sources do not give is a studio by studio breakdown. Neither Rockstar's launch post nor Take-Two's release says which office built which part of GTA 6, and we did not find one in the 10-K. We list the offices below without guessing their roles.

Where is Rockstar Games based?

Rockstar Games is based in New York City. The 10-K states: "Rockstar's corporate offices occupy approximately 97,000 square feet of leased office space in New York, New York, under leases expiring in March 2030." On its careers page, Rockstar New York is listed in Manhattan.

Its parent company is in the same city. Take-Two's principal executive offices are "located at 110 West 44th Street (also known as 1133 Avenue of the Americas), New York, New York," in about 102,000 square feet under a lease running to December 2037, the 10-K says.

Scotland matters too. Rockstar North is listed in Edinburgh, and the 10-K notes that Take-Two's UK subsidiary "owns two office buildings in Edinburgh, U.K." The filing does not say which team uses those buildings, so we do not link them to a specific studio.

All 13 Rockstar offices and where they are

This is the office list as Rockstar's careers page showed it on November 25, 2026, with the city the page gives for each one. The last column counts the job listings on Rockstar's openings page that same day.

By our count, that is 4 offices in the United States, 5 in the United Kingdom, and 1 each in Canada, India and Australia, plus Rockstar International with no city given. Rockstar's careers page invites applicants to "join a tight-knit team responsible for creating and publishing" games including the Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead series.

Who runs Rockstar Games

Sam Houser. Take-Two's release of November 20, 2026 quotes him as "Sam Houser, President and Founder of Rockstar Games," and its company profile says: "Founded by Sam Houser in 1998, Rockstar Games pioneered the open-world genre of video games with the launch of Grand Theft Auto III in 2001."

In that release, Houser said: "We are incredibly humbled by the response from players around the world and we couldn't be more excited to share this moment with you." The same release reported day one retail sales of $3.79 billion, "based on company estimates through end of day November 19th worldwide." We break down that figure in our guide to GTA 6 sales.

People also search for a "Rockstar CEO." The sources we read do not use that title for anyone at Rockstar; the title they give Houser is President and Founder. Rockstar sits inside Take-Two, which has its own leadership and shareholders, covered in our guide to who owns GTA 6.

How many people work on Rockstar's games

Take-Two does not report a headcount for Rockstar alone in the 10-K we read. For the whole company, which also includes 2K and Zynga, it says: "Our headcount includes 12,909 full-time employees as of March 31, 2026, including 9,998 in development studios." By our arithmetic, that puts about 77% of Take-Two's full-time staff in development studios.

Treat any single "Rockstar staff" number you see elsewhere with care unless it names its source. The company figure above is the one Take-Two put in a filing.

Where Rockstar was hiring after the GTA 6 launch

We counted every job listing on Rockstar's openings page on November 25, 2026, six days after launch. There were 16 listings across 9 of the 13 offices. Eleven of them sat under the "Security" or "Security IT" departments, about 69% of the total.

  • Anti-cheat and game security: "Senior Cheat Software Engineer" was listed at Rockstar Dundee and Rockstar North, and Dundee also listed a "Game Security Analyst."
  • Threat intelligence: "Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst" was posted at five offices: Dundee, New England, New York, San Diego and Toronto.
  • Application and infrastructure security: New York listed a "Senior Application Security Platform Engineer," and India listed a "Senior Security Vulnerability Engineer" and a "Security Compliance Operations Lead."
  • Everything else: two graphics programmer roles in Australia, a workplace coordinator in Leeds, an admin coordinator in New England and a technical research analyst in Toronto.

A listing is a posting, not a head count: the same role can be posted at several offices, and a single post can cover more than one hire. Still, the mix is clear. On that day, most of the roles Rockstar advertised were security roles. We do not know when each role was first posted, or how the mix looked before launch.

A warning on fake Rockstar job offers

Rockstar's openings page carries this notice: "Recruitment scams are increasingly common, and scammers may impersonate Rockstar Games Human Resources personnel to seem more convincing."

A famous studio after a record launch is an easy name to borrow. Before you answer a message that offers a job at Rockstar, check that the role appears on Rockstar's own openings page. For the scams aimed at players around the launch, see our guide to GTA 6 early access scams.

The business lesson: after launch, security is the job

Take-Two said GTA 6's day one sales set "a new record for entertainment across any medium." Six days later, most of the job listings at the studio behind it were security roles: anti-cheat engineers, threat intelligence analysts and an application security engineer. One day's snapshot does not prove why, but the lesson is a common one: a popular launch draws more attention, including from fraudsters.

The same holds at a much smaller scale for any business that launches something popular, from an online store to a new app: more customers bring more attempts at fraud, account takeover and look-alike messages that use your name. faqs: Rockstar Games made GTA 6. Take-Two's annual report says Rockstar's titles are primarily internally developed, and Take-Two's release of November 20, 2026 calls Rockstar Games a label of Take-Two Interactive.

In New York City. Take-Two's 10-K says Rockstar's corporate offices occupy about 97,000 square feet of leased space in New York, New York, and Rockstar's careers page lists Rockstar New York in Manhattan.
Who is the president of Rockstar Games?
Sam Houser. Take-Two's release of November 20, 2026 names him President and Founder of Rockstar Games and says he founded the company in 1998.
How many offices does Rockstar Games have?
Rockstar's careers page listed 13 offices on November 25, 2026: North, New York, San Diego, New England, LA, Toronto, London, Leeds, Lincoln, Dundee, India, Australia and Rockstar International.
Rockstar has not published a studio by studio breakdown in the launch materials we read, so we do not assign roles. The launch announcements attribute it to Rockstar Games as a whole.
How many people work at Rockstar Games?
Take-Two does not report a Rockstar-only headcount in its 10-K. Company wide, including 2K and Zynga, it had 12,909 full-time employees on March 31, 2026, of whom 9,998 were in development studios.

image.takeaway: Rockstar Games made GTA 6; on November 25, 2026 it listed 13 offices and has its corporate offices in New York City.
